ValidationRule.description: Status cannot revert to previous status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deposit" && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Deposit Required") && Deposit_Received__c = TRUE && NOT(ISBLANK(Deposit_Received_Date__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Deposit_Amount_Received__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once deposit is received, the status cannot be reverted.
